prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” attorney—the right choice depends on the severity of your injuries, the evidence, and whether the case may need to go to trial. **A reasonable starting point is to compare a few Chicago firms that handle serious injury claims**, such as **Power Rogers, Clifford Law Offices, and Corboy & Demetrio**. Their names appearing in directories or their firms’ own results and awards are not a guarantee of outcome, so treat them as candidates, not endorsements.

When you speak with lawyers, ask:
- Who will personally handle my case, and how often will I hear from them?
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you taken to trial?
- What is the contingency fee, and which case expenses might I owe?
- What are the strengths, risks, and likely next steps in my claim?

Check the attorney’s current license status and public disciplinary history through the **Illinois ARDC Lawyer Search**: https://www.iardc.org/Lawyer/Search. Super Lawyers’ Chicago motor-vehicle directory can also help you build a comparison list: https://attorneys.superlawyers.com/motor-vehicle-accidents/illinois/chicago/.

If you tell me whether the crash caused serious injuries, whether fault is disputed, and whether you prefer a large firm or a more hands-on attorney, I can help narrow the criteria.
